title: No MCP protocol server — FastAPI REST implemented instead
evidence: server.py:12 `from fastapi import FastAPI`; endpoints are HTTP POST (server.py:422,468,515,571,698) served by uvicorn on port 8000 (server.py:813-815). Repo-wide grep for `import mcp|fastmcp|modelcontextprotocol|mcp.server|FastMCP|list_tools|call_tool|stdio_server` returns nothing. No tool/resource registration, no stdio transport. 'MCP' appears only as free text in docstrings/titles (server.py:3,360,412) and even the agent's own stdout log calls it a 'FastAPI server'.
suggestion: Re-implement using an MCP SDK (mcp / fastmcp): expose the query functions as registered @tool handlers over stdio transport instead of REST endpoints.

title: Competition filter cannot reliably distinguish the three competitions
evidence: query_matches concatenates all five match DataFrames (server.py:436) without tagging each row's source competition, then filters by searching the substring in 'tournament'/'competition'/'round' columns (server.py:448-452). The Brasileirão, Copa do Brasil and Libertadores CSVs carry no column whose value names the competition, so competition='Libertadores' matches nothing from the Libertadores file.
suggestion: Add a 'competition' column when loading each CSV (e.g. data['libertadores']['competition']='Libertadores') so the filter can select across the provided competition datasets.

title: date_from/date_to query params declared but never applied
evidence: MatchQuery declares date_from and date_to (server.py:379-380) but query_matches (server.py:422-465) filters only on team/season/competition — the date-range fields are dead. R4 is still satisfied via the season filter (server.py:444-446).
suggestion: Apply date_from/date_to against the parsed match datetime, or drop the unused fields.

title: Most tests gate their assertions behind `if ... in DATA` guards
evidence: test_server.py wraps assertions in conditionals such as `if 'brasileirao' in DATA:` (e.g. test_server.py:99,114,159,269) — if a dataset failed to load the test would pass without asserting anything. Only test_data_loaded (test_server.py:29-32) unconditionally asserts DATA is non-empty.
suggestion: Use a session fixture that fails fast if required datasets are missing, so guarded tests cannot silently no-op.

title: Team-name normalization and five typed query endpoints beyond minimal spec
evidence: normalize_team_name (server.py:137-161) plus a TEAM_NAME_MAPPING table handle suffix/accent variants; five pydantic-typed endpoints (/matches,/teams,/players,/competitions,/stats) and top-scorer/biggest-win aggregates (server.py:670-810) exceed the minimum query set.
